name: PR finding: 'Turn into eval case' dialog shows the draft and flags the existing case
description: From PR #482 open the Agent runs tab, make sure the accepted Stripe finding ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit', src/config.ts:12) is expanded (the first finding of the newest run opens by default, so the header is only clicked when the action row is not rendered yet) and click 'Turn into eval case'. The dialog is labelled 'Turn into eval case', the 'Must find' radio is checked and the read-only File / Lines show src/config.ts and 12. The seeded review has no agent, so the 'Owner agent' picker is shown (AC-9); picking Security Reviewer (which already has a seeded case linked to this finding) swaps Save for 'Already an eval case' with a link (AC-10). Closed with Escape. Read-only: never clicks Save or any run button, so no model call. Needs the API started with PROJECT_DOCS_SOURCE=fixture, which seeds the accepted finding and the linked case (see e2e/README.md).
